project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 SPA (Athen learning platform), Supabase backend
build_system: npm + Vite 7. node/npm may need: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". Verified node v22.23.3.
test_framework: vitest (vitest run). Existing unit tests live under src/features/**/__tests__/*.test.ts and cover pure helper logic.
build_command: npm run build  (runs: tsc -b && vite build — this is the authoritative Vercel check; verified GREEN at baseline on commit 89ac0a8)
test_command: npm run test  (vitest run); also npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint (eslint .)
verification_instructions: Run in order: npm run typecheck, npm run lint (NO NEW warnings; a few pre-existing warnings exist in untouched files), npm run test, npm run build. Build must be clean. Much of this task is CSS/markup and only visually verifiable without a live browser.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is build output (gitignored-ish, not reviewed). src/types/database.ts is generated and MUST NOT be edited. No snapshot test fixtures relevant here.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in node_modules. If node missing: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH". Working on a NEW feature branch off main (do NOT commit on main).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No live browser for visual verification. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles publish). Ignore the parked git stash@{0}.
contribution_requirements: Frontend-only task. Do NOT touch supabase/migrations, src/types/database.ts, or src/types/db.ts. No new backend/data-layer schema changes. Styling via CSS custom properties in src/styles/theme.css (NOT Tailwind). Do NOT import anything from the reference repo _ref-athen. Keep lint clean with no new warnings.
key_patterns: Many components use inline styles (Modal.tsx, LessonRunner.tsx, question components, Input.tsx). The dashboard + brand use CSS classes in src/styles/theme.css (prefixes: .dash__*, .app-shell__*, .nb-overlay*). Brand purple = var(--brand-purple) (#5b2a86 light / #a877dd dark). Gold used in logo = #FFC107. Data access via @tanstack/react-query hooks in feature api.ts files; mutations invalidate query keys on success. useRenameNotebook ALREADY EXISTS in src/features/notebook/api.ts (reuse it). UI primitives: src/components/ui/{Button,Input,Modal,Spinner,ErrorText}.tsx.
relevant_files: src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx (trail container .dash__trail bound to trailRef, spreads dragHandlers; lesson Modal host)
src/components/ui/Modal.tsx (shared modal; inline-styled; content area is <div style={{ padding:'1.25rem', overflowY:'auto' }}>)
src/features/lesson/LessonRunner.tsx (lesson pop-up body: header/content <section whiteSpace:pre-wrap>/questions/footer, inline styled)
src/features/lesson/questions/QuestionComponents.tsx (question prompt + inputs; prompt rendered in LessonRunner QuestionItem header)
src/features/notebook/NotebookPage.tsx (full /notebook page; notebook list buttons + delete)
src/features/landing/LandingPage.tsx (uses BrandMark size=36 + Logo size=96 — do NOT lowercase these)
src/features/auth/AuthCard.tsx + src/routes/NotFoundPage.tsx (use BrandMark with wordmark — leave 'Athen')
directory_structure: src/features/<domain>/ with api.ts + page/component .tsx + __tests__/; src/components/{ui,brand,layout}; src/styles/theme.css is the single global stylesheet; public/ holds static assets incl. athen-logo.svg favicon.
